title: driver-sql: connect() always runs PRAGMA auto_vacuum = INCREMENTAL, so read-only probes (os migrate duplicates) bump the SQLite header — the "no-op" docblock and "writes nothing at all" doc are untrue
body:
QA-source: #21721 · cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory · outside the item's clauses

Found while judging `cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory` A3 in the 17.7 pre-release run #21721 (subject `251a7dd4`); verifier V6 isolated it: low. The clause itself was scored an assertion defect (the command declares rows and counters unchanged, which holds); this card is the product side.

## Reproduction

Boot a scaffold once (`os dev --no-watch -d file:X.db`), stop, copy X.db, `md5sum`, run `os migrate duplicates --database-url file:{copy}`, `md5sum` again: the md5 changes. `cmp -l` shows two bytes, at offsets 27 and 95 — the SQLite file change counter (24–27) and version-valid-for (92–95). Rows and `sqlite_master` are identical.

Isolated with better-sqlite3 on copies (the DB is already `auto_vacuum=2`, `journal_mode=wal`): `PRAGMA auto_vacuum = INCREMENTAL` alone changes the file; reading either pragma, setting `journal_mode = WAL`, or open/close leave it byte-identical.

## Mechanism

`SqlDriver.applyAutoVacuumIncremental`, run unconditionally from `connect()` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts:6923,6945`); its docblock (~6929-6943) says "Harmless / no-op … on already-incremental databases". `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:1114` says the command "writes nothing at all".

## Fix options

Skip the pragma when `PRAGMA auto_vacuum` already reads 2 (or on read-only probe boots), or correct the docblock and the doc.
